company.name: DentaCarts
company.shortDescription: DentaCarts is a FinTech-Enabled Data-Driven Marketplace for Medical Supplies in MENA providing the widest range of authentic products
company.description:
DentaCarts is a technology company specialized in e-commerce and supply-chain in the dental field in the MEA region. The company provides digital platforms to disrupt the traditional way of ordering and stock keeping of products.
With operations in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Germany DentaCarts served more than 3000 dental businesses over its first four years, Thanks to the platform with 30K listed products and 150+ agents and product suppliers in the market.
Our digital platforms focus on two areas; the first one is the order capture process where we provide a special B2B e-commerce platform. The second area is the stock-keeping/supply-chain part of the dental business; where we provide cloud and IoT solutions for automating the business processes.
The vision of DentaCarts is to lead the commerce of dental supplies in the MEA region using the power of digital platforms.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $450,000, or 80.36% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $361,479 to $3,577,032, a 9.9x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
